verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a connectivity platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack shows no official Tailscale MCP server. It does show adjacent items: tsidp can secure third-party MCP servers, there is a Tailscale skill for coding agents, and there is an Aperture gateway/CLI for agents. None of these is an MCP server that an agent can connect to, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
